answer_text:
There isn’t one single “best” site for everyone—what’s best depends on whether you prioritize price, premium quality, fast shipping, or used deals. Here are the top options by category (US-focused):

## Best overall (selection + shipping)
- **Amazon** – Huge selection (dumbbells, benches, racks, accessories), fast shipping/returns. Best when you want convenience and easy returns.  
- **Walmart** – Good prices on entry-level gear, easy returns, often cheaper bundles.

## Best for serious strength equipment (racks, barbells, plates)
- **Rogue Fitness** – Excellent quality, made-in-USA options, strong customer support. Often the “gold standard” for powerlifting/garage gyms.
- **REP Fitness** – High value for racks/benches/plates; great balance of quality and price.
- **Titan Fitness** – Budget-friendly heavy equipment; quality can be less consistent, but good deals.

## Best for cardio machines
- **NordicTrack / ProForm (iFIT)** – Treadmills, bikes, rowers with integrated training ecosystem (good if you want classes).
- **Concept2** (direct) – RowErg/SkiErg/BikeErg; very reliable and holds value.

## Best for used / big savings
- **Facebook Marketplace** – Often the best prices locally (especially for plates, dumbbells, benches).
- **Craigslist / OfferUp** – Good for local pickup deals.
- **Play It Again Sports** (if nearby) – Used equipment with some inspection/return ability.

## Best for deals and discounted overstock
- **Dick’s Sporting Goods** – Frequent sales, decent midrange gear, easy returns.
- **Costco** – Great value bundles when available; strong return policy.

### Quick recommendation
- If you want **highest quality strength gear**: **REP Fitness** (value) or **Rogue** (premium).
- If you want **cheapest solid setup**: **Facebook Marketplace** + **Titan** for what you can’t find used.
- If you want **simple, fast delivery**: **Amazon**.

If you tell me your budget, space (e.g., apartment vs garage), and what you want (rack/barbell vs adjustable dumbbells vs cardio), I can point to the best specific sites and models.
